cpu_contract.stack_qualification: Every ESP formula additionally requires the current SS stack-address attribute to be 32-bit; x86:LE:32 program metadata does not establish live SS. With 16-bit SS, no stated ESP formula is asserted. Qualified arithmetic wraps modulo 2^32.
cpu_contract.current_memory: Every load/store refers to memory at that instruction execution time; no validity, disjointness, frame identity, or value persistence across opaque calls is assumed.
cpu_contract.entry_call: For current entry ESP=T, the local unprefixed E8 stores the 32-bit return address 00BFBA0E at current SS:[T-4], leaves ESP=T-4, and transfers EIP to numeric 00C05B68. This one instruction preserves other general registers, including EBP, and arithmetic flags. This says nothing about the callee.
cpu_contract.opaque_callee: No target bytes, prototype, service, data, or ownership are authenticated. Return is not established. If control later resumes at 00BFBA0E, every returned register including EAX, ESI, EBP and ESP, all flags, and memory are unconstrained. No preservation or stack restoration is propagated.
cpu_contract.accepted_caller_zero_edge: After the earlier opaque call resumes at C05234, let current EAX=A1 and ESP=Q1; all other returned state is unknown. The accepted local MOV ESI,EAX and TEST ESI,ESI reach the zero edge only when A1=0. PUSH 16 at C0523A and E8 at C0523C then enter BFBA09 with T=Q1-8 and EAX=ESI=0. Their stores write 16 at SS:[Q1-4] and C05241 at SS:[Q1-8] at their own execution times. The new entry E8 then writes BFBA0E at SS:[Q1-12] and enters C05B68 with ESP=Q1-12 and EAX=ESI=0. Other registers remain the unknown current values through these local instructions. None of these relations extend across either opaque callee.
cpu_contract.flags_on_local_zero_path: The caller TEST of zero clears CF/OF/SF, sets ZF/PF, and leaves AF undefined. Local MOV/PUSH/CALL do not change these arithmetic flags before entry into C05B68. All flags become unconstrained across the opaque C05B68 call.
